abstention_rules: At least two supported findings must be assessed
Confirmed-observation coverage must be at least 0.50
At least one non-unknown evidence family must contribute
aggregation_rules: Engineering-only profile over explicitly unreviewed assertions
Average assessed assertion contributions inside each evidence family
Monarch republications share an evidence family with a matching Orphadata assertion
MedlinePlus assertions with unknown editorial dependencies are not aggregated
Weights are unvalidated engineering parameters, never clinical probabilities
coverage_rules: Only confirmed resolved observations count as supported
Unknown and unevaluable findings have no numeric contribution
Only direct identifiers or exact/equivalent resolved mappings may score
out_of_scope_rules: Age below 18 years is outside this engineering profile
Missing or ambiguous age prevents adult-scope reasoning
This profile is local_research_only and has no clinical validation

score_scale.description: Unreviewed deterministic compatibility for local engineering research; never a clinical probability
